_doc: 蛇 Snake assistant actions (fase 15): the ONLY things the assistant can propose. The model answers an id; the shell shows argv and runs `ocarina-snake run-action <id> --confirmed` only after the user presses «Ejecutar». argv[0] must be «ocarina». Nothing destructive, everything reversible.
